proposals.title: Basel Committee on Banking Supervision — Stress testing principles, October 2018
proposals.use: Historical high-level method context; the numerical contracts, proofs and scenarios are original.
proposals.verification: Actually retrieved the final 15-page official PDF. Read introduction printed 1/PDF 5 and substantive principles 1–8, printed 3–10/PDF 7–14, including objectives, consistency, data, risk interactions and challenge. Earlier root retrieval alone was not counted as this body inspection. No national legal implementation or calibration is inferred; the final communication principle is not used for additional claims.

scope: Accepted chapter prerequisites supply discounting, accounting and dated-cash methods. No new empirical data, estimated stress likelihoods or general network theorem is imported. The two-node result is proved under its own stated contracts; the broader literature is not claimed fully audited.
